record.diagnosis_text: Type 2 diabetes mellitus with diabetic ketoacidosis
record.clinical_notes: Patient ko pehle se sugar (diabetes) tha, 2 din se ulti aur pet dard ho raha tha aur hosh bhi thoda kam tha. Blood sugar bahut zyada tha (485) aur DKA confirm hua blood test se. ICU mein IV insulin drip start ki gayi, saath mein fluids aur potassium bhi diya gaya. Dhire dhire sugar aur acidosis control hua, 36 ghante mein patient normal hone laga. Discharge ke time patient poori tarah hosh mein tha, insulin injection lene ki salah di gayi ghar par.
